title: Ten wheels on one office chair
body:
The five casters now swivel, and each pair of wheels can roll at different speeds through a turn. I separated them from the original fused Meshy chair mesh, then used the same wheels for the second finish.

In the Godot lab, I can walk up and push any of four chairs. Each finish has a plain rolling version and one with a short spring at every caster. A rolling sound cut from an Omni chair clip follows wheel speed and goes quiet when the chair stops.

videos.caption: The new finish on the spring chair. From the front you can see the casters swivel as it changes direction.
The same push on the original finish, with rigid casters on the left and short springs on the right. The lower views follow one caster.
Both finishes follow the same movement as the camera drops from the worn upholstery to the shared wheels.
A first-person test in Godot. I walk up to the spring chair and push it across the room.
